chapter: Las Vegas, Sinatra and later years
title: Touring with Sinatra in Australia and Vegas
summary: With a small band or a big band in Sydney and Melbourne, Norvo says Sinatra just counted off the tempo and they swung.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: And then maybe some -- he'd do it with a small band on the stage.
Why did he have -- he had his own arrangements for either sized band or something, huh?
Yeah, he'd take along some of the big band arrangements so if he --
Would you conduct the big band?
Couple times -- the first time we went we didn't use them. We just used a small band.

And in Melbourne and Sydney -- next time we went back we worked Melbourne and then he used a bigger band in (Unintelligible) arena in Sydney, I remember. I don't know it was -- it was fun. Then he went into Vegas with us, couple of times.
Yeah. Worked -- and they had a big band in the Sands. And that was -- that was fun.
Well conduct it, I played. You know, we just all played. Frank would beat off.
He'd just beat off the tempo.
And, we'd just play after that --
-- there was nobody -- stop -- we just swung out and we knew what --
-- he beat off the tempo he'd want.
And maybe do a tune with just a piano. Bass and drums.
It was kind of nice, I enjoyed -- I -- I really enjoyed working with him. He was so -- so -- so nice. He's -- I really loved the guy, I think he's a wonderful man.
I'm very -- I think he's very honest and he's sincere.
